name: AutoCraft Player
author: AutoCraft Lab

sections.description:
Transform your website’s media with AutoCraft Player, the most versatile and customizable audio and video player for WordPress. Engage your audience with stunning, branded media experiences that are easy to create and manage.

The Most Customizable WordPress Media Player Is Here ★★★★★

Audio and video are powerful tools to connect with visitors. AutoCraft Player empowers you to create exceptional media experiences with its 100% customizable UI, drag-and-drop playlists, and extensive control options.

[Screenshot of AutoCraft Player in action – Replace with your actual screenshot]

AutoCraft Player simplifies media management with global settings, pre-designed templates, and seamless integration with YouTube, Vimeo, HLS, and more.

AUTOCRAFT PLAYER IS PERFECT FOR

  • Content Creators: Enhance your blog posts and pages with engaging audio and video.
  • Educators: Deliver online courses and training videos with advanced player controls.
  • Podcasters: Showcase your audio content with customizable playlists and players.
  • Vloggers: Embed YouTube and Vimeo videos with seamless integration and branding.
  • Businesses: Use video marketing and training videos to connect with customers and employees.
  • Membership Sites: Provide exclusive media content to your members.
  • E-learning Platforms: Create interactive and engaging e-learning experiences.

AUTOCRAFT PLAYER’S GAME-CHANGING FEATURES

  • 100% Customizable Player UI: Design every aspect of your player, from colors and controls to layout and branding.
  • Custom Control Creation: Add your own controls with HTML, SVG, JavaScript, and CSS.
  • Drag-and-Drop Playlist Management: Organize audio and video playlists with ease.
  • Global Settings: Apply consistent settings across all your players and playlists.
  • Pre-Designed Templates: Choose from 10+ templates for audio, video, and playlists.
  • Broad Media Support: Play YouTube, Vimeo, HLS, MP4, MP3, and more.
  • Real-time Preview: See your changes instantly in the dashboard.
  • Dark and Light Mode: Choose your preferred dashboard theme.
  • Advanced Video.js Integration: Leverage all features of Video.js.
  • Shortcode Embedding: Easily embed players and playlists anywhere on your site.
  • Privacy Controls: Set players and playlists to public, private, or unlisted.
  • Captions and Subtitles: Make your content accessible to a wider audience.
  • Playback Speed Control: Let viewers adjust the playback speed.
  • Loop Playback: Enable continuous looping of media.
  • Autoplay Option: Automatically start media playback.
  • Responsive Design: Ensure your players look great on all devices.
  • Mobile-Friendly: Optimized for mobile viewing.
  • Accessibility Features: Improve accessibility for users with disabilities.

Why AutoCraft Player is a Game-Changer?

  • Unmatched Customization: Create unique and branded media experiences.
  • Ease of Use: Intuitive dashboard and drag-and-drop functionality.
  • Feature-Rich: Advanced features for control, customization, and accessibility.
  • Flexibility: Seamless integration with various media sources and page builders.

sections.installation:
1. Upload the AutoCraft Player folder to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the AutoCraft Player plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu in WordPress.
sections.faq:
Does AutoCraft Player host my media files?

AutoCraft Player supports various hosting options, including self-hosting, remote URLs, YouTube, Vimeo, and any hosting that provides direct links to your media files.

Does AutoCraft Player work with my page builder?

Yes, AutoCraft Player works with all page builders. Use shortcodes for basic embedding or leverage custom JavaScript and CSS for advanced integration.

How do I customize the player’s appearance?

AutoCraft Player offers 100% UI customization. Modify colors, controls, layout, and add custom controls using HTML, SVG, JavaScript, and CSS.

What media formats are supported?

AutoCraft Player supports MP4, MP3, HLS, YouTube, Vimeo, and all formats supported by Video.js.

Can I create playlists?

Yes, create audio and video playlists with drag-and-drop ease.

How do I add captions or subtitles?

Add captions and subtitles directly from the UI, supporting standard formats.

Is AutoCraft Player mobile-friendly?

Yes, it’s 100% mobile-friendly with a responsive design.
